correctness.rationale: The norm embedding yields a restricted Hermitian operator-norm perturbation epsilon on the next Krylov space. The exact SPD turning-angle bound follows by \(A^2\preceq(\mu+L)A-\mu LI\) and one-variable minimization. Its combination with the generalized eigenvector Rayleigh quotient establishes the real-part bound, including complex eigenvectors. An actual 2-by-3 sketch has exact distortion epsilon and produces a scalar sketched Ritz value whose numerator changes sign at precisely \(2\sqrt\kappa/(1+\kappa)\); the positive denominator is verified. The package verifier passed 25,308 exact rational checks; the infinite-dimensional-parameter statement is analytically proved.

value.rationale: The sharp threshold answers when a standard sketched FOM matrix-function method retains the positive-real spectrum required for safe evaluation of reciprocal and Stieltjes functions. It improves substantially on the crude \(\varepsilon<1/\kappa\) spectral enclosure (at \(\kappa=9\), the sharp boundary is \(\varepsilon=3/5\) instead of the crude \(\varepsilon=1/9\)), is attained by a natural minimal Krylov configuration with a truly compressive sketch, and establishes an unavoidable obstruction rather than just a small numerical change. No probabilistic embedding or runtime guarantee is asserted.
